island.label: An island of the places this story happens in — pick one to look closer

bahay-kubo.title: bahay kubo
bahay-kubo.body: This is my home, the place I grew up in. A simple house, a simple life, and a simple way of being.

shore.title: the shore
shore.body: I was raised in the island's shore, where the sea meets the land. The place that taught me to be patient, to be resilient, and to be resourceful.

sari-sari.title: the sari-sari store
sari-sari.body: Small business, big heart. The place where I learned the value of hard work, and the importance of community. it's the usual place to get a snack, a drink, or a chat with the neighbors.

duomo.title: Milan
duomo.body: Marble spires on the other side of the island. The city I work from now, a long way from the first one.

tram.title: the tram
tram.body: traditional public transport, a moving window to the city. The place where I learned to observe, to listen, and to appreciate the small things in life.

studio.title: the studio
studio.body: Growing up I didn't have a studio, but I had a dream. A place where I could create, explore, and express myself. now I have one, and it's the place where I can be myself, and where I can share my work with the world.

easel.title: the easel
easel.body: Everything you can imagine is real -Pablo Picasso.

graves.title: the graves
graves.body: Two crosses on the quiet side of the island, each hung with the hat its owner wore. Proof a story can end and still keep teaching you something, years later.

inspiration.verse: God said, "Let there be light", and there was light
